name: Mode
source:
Main character works in a promotion company, but due to recession each division starts to act separately and finance itself from the revenues. He gets a task to supervise mobile site. Wait, but it's an adult site! He has three months to attract 10,000 paid members or he gets broke.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一家宣传公司工作。由于经济衰退，各部门开始独立运营，并用收入维持自身。一天，他接到监督手机网站的任务。等等，这竟然是成人网站！他只有三个月时间吸引一万名付费会员，否则就会破产。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
